$A(t)=-\dfrac{6}{25}t^2+\dfrac{6}{5}t$

$-\dfrac{12}{25}t+\dfrac{6}{5}=0$

Let the number of mystery gift bags be $x$.

The total number of bags $=4x$

$\dfrac{x}{4x}\times\dfrac{x-1}{4x-1}=\dfrac{7}{118}$

$\dfrac{1}{4}\times\dfrac{x-1}{4x-1}=\dfrac{7}{118}$

$\dfrac{x-1}{4x-1}=\dfrac{28}{118}$

$118x-118=112x-28$

$x=15$

$\mathrm{P}(\text{gift and gift})=\mathrm{P}(\text{gift at first draw})\times\mathrm{P}(\text{gift at second draw})$

$\dfrac{7}{118}=\dfrac{1}{4}\times\mathrm{P}(\text{gift at second draw})$

$\mathrm{P}(\text{gift at second draw})=\dfrac{7}{118}\div\dfrac{1}{4}=\dfrac{14}{59}$

Therefore $\mathrm{P}(\text{gift at first draw})=\dfrac{15}{60}$
